#  chain 2/3: Mappings/wortnetz__http_lvr_vocnet_org_wnk__unknown_target_scheme.sssom.tsv (tower -narrowMatch-> aat:300004847) + Mappings/dai_aat.sssom.tsv (dai Turm -exactMatch-> aat:300004847, read via symmetry) + Mappings/dai__http_thesauri_dainst_org_scheme__http_thesauri_dainst_org_scheme.sssom.tsv (dai tower alone -exactMatch-> dai Turm, via symmetry; dai tower alone -closeMatch-> dai Observation tower)

#comment: none of these chains could be composed by SKOS itself - only skos:exactMatch is transitive per the SKOS Reference; closeMatch/broadMatch/narrowMatch/relatedMatch are explicitly NOT, "to avoid the possibility of compound errors when combining mappings across more than two concept schemes" (SKOS Reference, Section 8.1). amt:RoleChainAxiom is what makes the composition possible, with a degraded weight rather than a blind assumption.

#comment_2: weight_source=GSAS means the real minimal-model degree (exactMatch=1.0, closeMatch=0.9381, both reused unchanged from scenario 2). weight_source=BORROWED-ILLUSTRATIVE means GSAS does not calibrate this predicate at all (broadMatch/narrowMatch are outside all four GSAS models) - the relatedMatch degree (0.4947) is used here as a reasoned analogy (narrowMatch, like relatedMatch, is looser than an equivalence-type match), NOT a GSAS value for narrowMatch itself. See the scenario README for why this is a judgement call, not a fact.
